title: Evidence provenance bundle and reproducible handoff
objective: Package the completed M0-M4 evidence lineage into a reproducible handoff artifact without moving policy into executable code.

in_scope: M0-M4 provenance, handoff metadata and deterministic verification

deliverables.name: Provenance manifest
deliverables.acceptance: Declare phase reports, replay tools, profiles and toolchain as data.

deliverables.name: Independent provenance verifier
deliverables.acceptance: Reject missing files, stale hashes and non-ready phases without running theorem synthesis.

deliverables.name: Handoff negative corpus
deliverables.acceptance: Reject temporary provenance and report mutations.

deliverables.name: Reproducible handoff report
deliverables.acceptance: Emit a hash-bound report suitable for a later phase or reviewer.

deliverables.name: M5 readiness gate
deliverables.acceptance: Produce a machine-checkable handoff readiness report.
